item_short_desc: Rothco's Canvas Israeli Type Bag is built tough for all your adventures, from the battlegrounds to camping trips. Made of heavyweight canvas with reinforced vinyl handles, it's durable and easy to carry.
description: Rothco's Canvas Israeli Type Bag is built tough for all your adventures, from the battlegrounds to camping trips. Made of heavyweight canvas with reinforced vinyl handles, it's durable and easy to carry. The waterproof bottom ensures your gear stays dry, while the exterior ID holder adds convenience. With three zippered outside pockets, three side zippered pockets, and hook and loop closed end pouches, it offers ample storage. Vinyl D-rings allow for additional equipment attachment. This spacious bag measures 34" x 15" x 12", providing plenty of room for all your essentials. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
